releaseNotes:
• 🔄 Smart Video-Adaptive Rotation: Automatically opens portrait/vertical videos upright (Shorts, Reels, TikTok) and landscape/widescreen videos horizontally in full cinematic mode
• ▶️ Circular Quick-Play Action: Replaced 'Open File' pill with a sleek glowing circular Play FAB that instantly resumes your most recent video with fluid animation
• 🔔 Automatic Update Notifications: Reliable notification delivery with high priority and direct system prompts for upcoming releases
• ⚡ Seamless Auto-Installer: Downloaded updates trigger the Android Package Installer automatically without manual file browsing
• 🎛️ 10-Option Video Menu & White Clean UI: Full suite of tools (Favorite, Playlist, Vault, MP3, Share, Cut, Delete, Properties)
